bio: Rebecca Cooke (born December 21, 1987) is an American politician, nonprofit founder, and former political consultant who is the U.S. representative-elect for Wisconsin's 3rd congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, Cooke defeated Republican incumbent Derrick Van Orden in the 2026 election after unsuccessfully running for the seat in 2022 and 2024. From 2019 to 2021, Cooke served on the board of the Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation.
